scope: Deterministic checks of a built fixture directory that scripts/capture_eval.py prepare runs before a preparation record exists, for every fixture id listed here. They read actual Git refs, the synthetic remote, uncommitted work the session did not make, external markers, and planted-defect state; a declared setup list is not evidence that any of those exist.

catalog-integration.why: Its end-state signals and the CTO prompts name origin fix/catalog, but its retained setup never creates that branch. A build that follows the retained setup literally fails here before a model starts, which is the defect the September 6 audit reported.

catalog-integration-ready.why: The canonical large-programme fixture: the branch its prompts name exists locally and on the synthetic origin, both planted edits are uncommitted, the publication marker is absent, and all four planted defects are still present.
catalog-integration-ready.head: fix/catalog

orders-service-integrated-leftover.why: The custody case requires a branch that is really merged and a worktree that is really registered and clean; a session that retires them must be retiring integrated state, and a setup that never merged or never registered would grade the wrong behavior.
orders-service-integrated-leftover.head: main

project-reconciliation.why: All three reconciliation cases depend on the same contradictory live project state: real local branches and worktrees, a local origin, and validation records bound to concrete revisions rather than retained placeholders.
project-reconciliation.head: main
